goal: HYPOTHESIS TEST (cont.319kk-g): does a UR10 build a single-xy COLUMN (sidestepping the grid-SPREAD wrist-flip limit)? 2 stacked cubes at one pick xy -> 2-slot column drop_targets at the Tray.
code:
# UR10 COLUMN-RECEIVER hypothesis test (cont.319kk-g): does a UR10 build a single-xy COLUMN (multi-z drop_targets
# at ONE xy) -> sidestepping the grid-SPREAD wrist-flip limit (project_isaac_assist_ur10_gridspread_limit, which
# was multi-TARGET xy-spread)? Adapts the PROVEN CP-CHAIN-UR10-RECV-NATIVE (suction pick @ raised [0,-0.4,0.975],
# deliver rel [0.5,-0.4]) to TWO cubes STACKED at the SAME pick xy (no pick-spread) + a 2-slot COLUMN drop_targets
# at the Tray. If the UR10 stacks a clean 2-column -> single-xy column works (robot-diversity multi-cube unlocked).
# If scatter/res_None/wrist-flip/reach-fail -> hypothesis refuted (UR10 multi-cube genuinely needs a real chain).
create_scene_baseline(table_size=[4.0, 3.5])

create_prim(prim_path="/World/UR10", prim_type="Xform")
add_reference(prim_path="/World/UR10", reference_path="/mnt/shared_data/isaac-sim-assets-complete-5.0.0/Assets/Isaac/5.0/Collected_Robots/ur10.usd")
teleport_prim(prim_path="/World/UR10", position=[0.5, -0.8, 0.75])

# Pedestal + TWO cubes STACKED at the proven pick xy [0,-0.4] (rel [-0.5,0.4] from base). Cube_1 top (1.025),
# Cube_2 below (0.975) so the suction picks top-down in list order.
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Pedestal", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.0, -0.4, 0.875], scale=[0.06, 0.06, 0.075])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Pedestal", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.0, -0.4, 1.025], size=0.05)
for api in ("PhysicsRigidBodyAPI", "PhysicsCollisionAPI", "PhysicsMassAPI", "PhysxRigidBodyAPI"):
    apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", schema_name=api)
bulk_set_attribute(prim_paths=["/World/Cube_1"], attr="physxRigidBody:sleepThreshold", value=0.0)
apply_physics_material(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", material_name="rubber")

create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cube_2", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.0, -0.4, 0.975], size=0.05)
for api in ("PhysicsRigidBodyAPI", "PhysicsCollisionAPI", "PhysicsMassAPI", "PhysxRigidBodyAPI"):
    apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_2", schema_name=api)
bulk_set_attribute(prim_paths=["/World/Cube_2"], attr="physxRigidBody:sleepThreshold", value=0.0)
apply_physics_material(prim_path="/World/Cube_2", material_name="rubber")

# Flat pallet base at [1.0,-1.2] (rel [0.5,-0.4] = proven deliver side); cubes COLUMN here.
create_prim(prim_path="/World/PalletBase", prim_type="Cube", position=[1.0, -1.2, 0.74], scale=[0.12, 0.12, 0.01])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/PalletBase", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

setup_pick_place_controller(
    robot_path="/World/UR10",
    robot_family="ur10",
    target_source="curobo",
    source_paths=["/World/Cube_1", "/World/Cube_2"],
    destination_path="/World/PalletBase",
    drop_targets=[[1.0, -1.2, 0.775], [1.0, -1.2, 0.825]],
    planning_obstacles=["/World/Table", "/World/PalletBase"],
)
verified_status: REFUTED-COLUMN / RCA-REFINED (cont.319kk-g): UR10 single-xy COLUMN does NOT sidestep the grid-spread limit. scene_eyes RAW @ dur=200: plan_fails=0 (UR10 REACHES the stacked pick z~1.17 AND the column places — NOT a reach/res_None failure), but STACK STRUCTURE = 1 z-level [0.775], both cubes settled 0.1m apart side-by-side, NO column formed. REFINED RCA: the UR10 limit is PLACEMENT-SCATTER (suction force-release ~0.1m precision), NOT xy-spread/wrist-flip -> it blocks ANY structured multi-cube (column AND grid), single-xy or not. PARTIAL CAPABILITY: UR10 multi-cube COLLECTION (unstructured -> zone/bin) WORKS (2/2 delivered to PalletBase within footprint); only structured (<0.06m precision) is blocked. Robot-diversity multi-cube = collection-only.
